        print("SKIP %-4s (quick mode)" % check_id)

        _state["failed"] += 1
        _state["failures"].append(check_id)

        if os.environ.get("HONE_VERBOSE"):
            traceback.print_exc()

        _state["passed"] += 1
        print("PASS %-4s%s" % (check_id, (" - " + detail) if detail else ""))
